newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Dec 30.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on December 30. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Eight children were seriously hurt when a grenade exploded in a mosque near the town of Tasikmalaya in West Java which last week was hit by racial and religious rioting.
A team from the official National Commission on Human Rights said it has found no human rights violations after a riot last week in Tasikmalaya in which at least four people died.
The Moslem-orientated United Development Party (PPP) has given its qualified support to a government ban on election rallies for next year's general election.
The Jakarta Stock Exchange plans to limit the fee which can be charged by its members to between one percent and 0.4 percent of the value of the transaction.

Sources in the Department of Tourism, Post and Telecommunications say the government is preparing to announce an increase in household telephone charges and a decrease in the cost of using mobile telephones.
